title.gateDoubled: ReaGate's Dry is at {{from, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB with Wet open, so your voice goes through it twice and jumps about 6 dB louder whenever the gate opens. Set Dry to {{to, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
title.tooLoud: Your voice is too loud and can distort: bring the compressor's Wet down {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB so your speech sits around {{target, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dBFS.
title.tooQuiet: Your voice is too quiet: bring the compressor's Wet up {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB so your speech gets closer to {{target, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dBFS.

deadSilence.noiseRemoval: Your pauses drop to dead silence, so the noise removal is cutting into your voice: turn its strength down a step. Pauses should sound quiet, not dead.
deadSilence.gate: Your pauses drop to dead silence, so the gate is closing on your voice: lower its Threshold {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB so it opens earlier. Pauses should sound quiet, not dead.

title.noisyPause: Your pauses still carry background noise and you want it gone: turn the noise removal's strength up a step.

high.boom: Too much boom: lower the 150 Hz low shelf by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
high.warmth: Your voice sounds thick: lower the 250 Hz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
high.mud: Your voice sounds muddy or boxy: lower the 450 Hz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
high.presence: Your voice sounds harsh: lower the 3.5 kHz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
high.sibilance: Your S sounds are sharp: lower the 10 kHz high shelf by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.

low.boom: Your voice lacks bass: raise the 150 Hz low shelf by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
low.warmth: Your voice sounds thin: raise the 250 Hz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
low.mud: Your voice sounds hollow: raise the 450 Hz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
low.presence: Your voice sounds dull or far away: raise the 3.5 kHz band by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
low.sibilance: Your voice lacks crispness: raise the 10 kHz high shelf by {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.

advice.undo: Put it back the way it was.
advice.conflict: That value was changed after you applied this, so Undo would overwrite your change. Set it back with its slider instead.
advice.missing: That effect or value isn't in the chain any more.

tune.idle: Pick your mic and headphones, then press Start. Nothing changes in Wave Link until you save.
tune.talk: Talk normally, as if you were streaming. The numbers fill in after a second or two.

warn.monitor: Mute your mic in Wave Link's monitor mix, or you will hear yourself twice. Or set Hear to Off and listen in Wave Link.
warn.reafir: ReaFIR adds 85 ms of that in this preview.

tune.fileError: Wave Link's settings couldn't be read, so saving is off. {{reason}}

save.title: Save to Wave Link
save.lead: These changes go into Wave Link. A backup is made first, then Wave Link closes, the file is written, and Wave Link starts again.
save.nothing: Nothing to save: your effects are the same as in Wave Link.
save.chain: {{plugin}}: the list of effects is different
save.unsaved: {{plugin}}: changes to this effect can't be saved yet, so Wave Link keeps its own setting.
save.saving: Saving… Wave Link closes and starts again.
save.force: Wave Link didn't close by itself. Close it by force? Anything not saved in Wave Link is lost.
save.done: Saved and checked: Wave Link has your new settings.
save.unchanged: Nothing had to change: Wave Link already has these settings.
save.notVerified: Written, but the check after saving didn't confirm every value. Open Wave Link and look at your effects.
save.notRunning: Wave Link wasn't running; it uses these settings the next time it starts.
save.forced: Wave Link was closed by force.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.lead: Pick the backup to put back. Wave Link closes, the backup is written over its settings, and Wave Link starts again.
restore.none: There are no backups yet. One is made every time you save to Wave Link.
restore.restoring: Restoring… Wave Link closes and starts again.
restore.restartPreview: To hear the restored settings here, press Stop and then Start.

errors.notRunning: The audio isn't running. Press Start first.
errors.noDevice: No microphone or headphones were found.
errors.deviceNotFound: The picked device isn't there any more. Pick it again.
errors.unsupportedFormat: That device can't run at 48 kHz. Pick another one or change its format in the Windows sound settings.
errors.streamFailed: The audio stopped because of a device error. Check the device and press Start again.
errors.settings: Wave Link's settings couldn't be read. Is Wave Link installed?
errors.queueFull: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notFound: Wave Link's settings file wasn't found.
errors.parse: Wave Link's settings file couldn't be read.
errors.changedMeanwhile: Wave Link's settings changed since you pressed Start. Press Stop and Start, then save again.
errors.missingEntry: An effect to change isn't in Wave Link any more.
errors.invalidChange: Something in the change isn't valid, so nothing was written.
errors.closeTimeout: Wave Link didn't close, so nothing was written.
errors.writeFailed: The file couldn't be written. Nothing changed, and your backup is safe.
errors.startFailed: The file was written, but Wave Link didn't start again. Start it yourself.
errors.verifyFailed: The file was written, but it doesn't hold every value. Restore the backup if Wave Link sounds wrong.
